title: Alpha Radioactivity Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: Provide a clear argument for why heavy nuclei are alpha-radioactive and stable against neutron-emission.

title: Nuclear Radius Methods
description: Important Criteria: Describe the two categories of methods used to determine nuclear radii and their principles.

title: Ground State Properties
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the properties that define a system of nucleons in its lowest energy state.

title: Fission Cross Section Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Explain the relationship between neutron number and fission cross sections for uranium isotopes.

title: Binding Energy Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: Discuss the significance of binding energy in the context of neutron-emission and fission.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for errors in understanding the conditions under which neutron-emission occurs.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure correct use of units and constants when discussing nuclear radii and cross sections.

title: Excitation Energy Clarification
description: Important Criteria: Clarify how excitation energy relates to fission barriers and the likelihood of fission occurring.
